text:
Predicates:
Aurochs(x) ::: x is an aurochs.
Extinct(x) ::: x is extinct.
Resemble(x, y) ::: x resembles y.
Animals(x) ::: x is an animal.
BredBack(x) ::: x is bred-back.
Questioned statement:
Aurochs are extinct.

Premises:
HeckCattle(x) ∧ BreededBack(x) ∧ Resemble(x, aurochs) ::: Heck cattle were bred-back to resemble the aurochs.
HeckCattle(x) ∧ Animals(x) ::: Heck cattle are animals.
Aurochs(x) ∧ Animals(x) ::: Aurochs are animals.
Some animals to be bred-back resemble animals that are extinct ::: ∃x ∃y (Animals(x) ∧ Animals(y) ∧ Resemble(x, y) ∧ Extinct(y))

Conclusion:
Extinct(aurochs)
